text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page triggered for service=redwood-inference-prod, escalation_policy=primary-oncall-rotation. Page delivered to responder 'infra-team' but incident severity looks like PLATFORM-level (db/gateway) — suspected routing rule mismatch.

marta: saw this — the page went to infra-team instead of platform-oncall. Getting duplicate alerts in infra.

jordan: confirmed, I can see the PD payload: rotation_id=rot_9f2a, rule_id=rule-rotate-3. Looks like the rotation mapping has platform -> infra.

pagerduty-bot: PD Event: INCIDENT.triggered id=INC_2026-03-14-0930. Acknowledgement status: unacked. Assigned to: infra-team oncall (user: lee). Escalation policy: primary-oncall-rotation.

marta: @lee did you get paged? can you ack and then I'll reassign if you aren't the right owner.

lee: yeah I got it. ack'ing now to stop noise, but i'm not the right owner for the gateway errors. ack

pagerduty-bot: User lee acknowledged incident INC_2026-03-14-0930.

jordan: I think the rotation config was accidentally updated yesterday during the rollout. Copying the snippet from the infra repo:

```
# rotations.yaml (excerpt)
- id: rot_9f2a
  name: primary-oncall-rotation
  participants:
    - infra-team
    - platform-oncall  # intended
  rules:
    - when: weekdays
      target: infra-team  # <-- incorrect, should be platform-oncall for gateway alerts
```

marta: yep that `target` line looks wrong. Maybe a templating bug in the rotation generator. @jordan can you patch and trigger a rotation sync?

jordan: on it. Pushing fix now, will update PD rule after sync.

sage: quick customer impact note — we got a handful of 502s from customer tenant 'acme-inc' between 09:28-09:34. Traffic spike + gateway error. Raising severity to P2 until routing is fixed.

lee: once patched, how do we ensure no more pages are misrouted?

jordan: plan: 1) push rotation fix to infra repo 2) trigger rotation-sync job 3) update PD escalation policy mapping to explicitly include service tags 4) run a dry-run test `pdctl test-route --service redwood-inference-prod`

marta: I'll take 3 and 4 after your patch. Also let's add an explicit test to CI that validates rotation targets for gateway services.

pagerduty-bot: PD Action: escalation_policy updated for primary-oncall-rotation by marta. New mapping: gateway-services -> platform-oncall.

incident-bot: note: paging suppressed to infra-team while reassigning to platform-oncall.

lee: forwarding my ack to platform-oncall @platform-oncall — transferring responsibility.

platform-oncall (system): received transfer of INC_2026-03-14-0930. Status: acknowledged by platform-oncall (user: jordan).

jordan: mitigating now — rolling back the last gateway deploy and warming caches for acme-inc. ETA 12m.

marta: communication for customers: sage, can you prepare a short blurb for affected tenants? we saw ~6 failed requests for acme-inc and errors may have impacted retries.

sage: drafting: "We experienced a brief routing-related gateway error affecting requests to acme-inc between 09:28–09:34 UTC. The issue has been mitigated; normal traffic resumed after 09:45. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with post-incident notes."

lee: re: followups — add rotation linting to the infra CI and add PD routing unit tests to prevent templating regressions.

jordan: fix deployed and rotation-sync job completed. Verified with `pdctl test-route`:
```
$ pdctl test-route --service redwood-inference-prod
route: platform-oncall (ok)
```

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC_2026-03-14-0930 status: resolved by platform-oncall. Duration: ~17m.

marta: thanks all. Action items: 1) jordan — open PR to add rotation linting (in flight) 2) lee/marta — add PD unit tests & CI gating 3) sage — customer followup email + incident timeline. I'll own the postmortem and include timeline + config diff.

incident-bot: Postmortem checklist created: pm-1754801123. Assigning to marta.

jordan: quick note — this one was low blast but noisy. Good catch on the templating edge-case. Recommend we enforce explicit service tags in rotation generator.

marta: Agreed. Closing thread for paging escalation coordination; will post updates in postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
